messages:
zoe: Noticing p95 spike on /v1/generate after the 23:50 canary to v3.8.1 (canary 12%). Start ~23:53 UTC.
marc: deploybot shows rollout to v3.8.1 at 23:50, canary=12% region=use1.
deploybot: (auto-signal) latency drift detected: p95 exceed threshold for 4m. Autorevert policy=warn-only in this window.
tia: Any obvious errors in logs?
marc: quick grep: increased retry bursts and `kv_cache_miss` events. No new exception names.
ops-kevin: Given dedicated tenants on this route, I'd avoid letting auto-revert flip. Propose manual soft-unwind dedicated canary 12%->0% over 5m, pin previous v3.8.0 for dedicated, collect traces 20m.
zoe: agree. Who runs the shift?
marc: I can: `rictl traffic shift --service generator --from v3.8.1 --to v3.8.0 --percent 12 --scope dedicated --duration 300s`
product-ani: I'll draft a short customer note if we pin. Keep it neutral.
marc: running shift now -> response: ok shifting 12->0 over 300s (dedicated).
deploybot: update: canary at 9% per rollout plan.
(2m)
marc: p95 improving as traffic leaves dedicated nodes, cpu on those nodes dropping.
tia: pin command: `rictl pin version --service generator --version v3.8.0 --scope dedicated --note "post-canary unwind 23:59 UTC"` -> ok pinned.
ops-kevin: opening rollback PR to revert canary manifests for dedicated only.
product-ani: customer blurb draft: "During a scheduled rollout we observed elevated latency on generation endpoints for dedicated pools. Traffic was shifted back to a stable version and we are investigating. No customer data impact."
marc: collecting traces now; will post early findings in ~10m.
(20m later)
marc: preliminary: kernel selection fell back to quant_path_alt on long-context requests triggering extra cache churn. Draft RCA to follow.
zoe: thanks. Decision: manual soft unwind executed, dedicated pinned to v3.8.0 for 24h pending RCA. Owners: marc (traces/RCA), ops-kevin (rollback PR), product-ani (customer comms). If errors remain >0.5% we'll escalate to hard revert. :thumbsup:
deploybot: canary drained to 0% for dedicated; rollout halted.
zoe: closing thread for immediate ops. Follow-ups in postmortem.
